description: Cross-language conformance for the path shapes a request URL and an OpenAPI path reduce to (issue #638, moved engine-side by #761). The engine owns operation matching now; the renderer still reduces the same shapes for the spec diff (services/openapi/spec-diff.ts) and the export skeleton (services/exporters/skeleton.ts), so two implementations of one rule exist until those move too. This table is what keeps them honest: engine/tests/operation_match_test.cpp and app/src/services/openapi/operation-shape.conformance.test.ts both read it, and a divergence fails ctest or vitest rather than reaching a user as a bind that matches nothing.

readers.requestUrls: both - `origin` and `path` (split_request_url / splitRequestUrl); `shape` is engine-only, since the renderer no longer reduces a request URL to a shape (that was the matcher's job)

requestUrls.name: the import's own spelling: a variable stands in for the whole origin
the query and the fragment are not part of what a URL addresses
both template syntaxes flatten to one placeholder
a trailing slash is not a different endpoint
the root survives the trailing-slash rule
an origin on its own states no path - not the root
a relative path states no origin, and gains the leading slash
a variable that is only part of the first segment is not the origin
an unclosed brace is text, not a placeholder
